intro: Armenia's economy is small but growing, with a strong IT sector, mining and money from the diaspora.

chapters.title: How Armenia earns
text: Copper and gold mining, brandy, IT and tourism are important. Its borders with Turkey and Azerbaijan have long been closed, which makes trade harder.

chapters.title: Tech
text: Software companies and start-ups have grown fast in Yerevan.

keyTerms.meaning: Money sent home by people working abroad.

cardGroups.title: Made in Armenia
cardGroups.intro: Some of the things Armenia makes and sells to the world.
